overview.description: The ProShares Ultra SpaceX ETF (SPCF) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in communication services equity. The fund provides 2x exposure to the daily returns of Space Exploration Technologies Corporation (NASDAQ: SPCX) stock, less expenses. SPCF was launched on Jun 12, 2026 and is issued by ProShares.
